q: Which domain carries the largest weight on the CCAO-F exam?
o: Domain 1 – Prompting and Task Execution
Domain 2 – Output Evaluation and Validation
Domain 4 – Workflow Integration and Solution Design
Domain 6 – Governance, Risk, and Responsible Use
e: D2 chiếm 21%, khoảng 13/60 câu. D4 16%, D6 15%, D1 14%. Bài 0.1.

q: Your score report shows 55% correct in Domain 7 but a total scaled score of 760. What is your result?
o: Fail, because every domain must reach 72%
Pass, because pass/fail depends only on the total scaled score; domain percentages are for information
Pending, until Domain 7 is retaken
Pass, but the credential is valid for 6 months instead of 12
e: Guide mục 9: % theo domain chỉ giúp bạn biết chỗ yếu, không dùng để quyết định đậu/rớt. Đậu khi điểm quy đổi tổng ≥ 720.

q: A colleague asks you to automate a reporting workflow by writing a custom integration against the Claude API. According to the exam guide, how should a Claude Certified Associate typically handle this?
o: Build the API integration personally, since associates are expected to design integrations
Use built-in features where they fit, and escalate the custom API integration to Claude Developers or Architects
Refuse, because Claude cannot be used for reporting
Ask Claude to write the integration and deploy it without review
e: Guide mục 3: Associate không thiết kế tích hợp hay kiến trúc; việc phức tạp hoặc kỹ thuật thì chuyển cho Architect và Developer. Bài 0.2.

q: Based on the official sample questions, which TWO answer patterns are typically scored as incorrect? (Choose TWO.)
o: Trusting an output because Claude stated it with high confidence
Verifying a cited figure against the original source before sharing
Abandoning the task when a safe way to complete it exists
Matching a lower-cost model to simple, high-volume work
Removing personal identifiers before uploading a file
e: Lời giải câu mẫu 1: độ tự tin tự báo không phải tín hiệu đáng tin. Câu mẫu 3: bỏ việc là không cần khi ẩn danh đã đủ an toàn. Ba phương án còn lại chính là đáp án đúng của các câu mẫu. Bài 0.3.

q: Besides the 30 objectives, the guide's preparation section tells candidates to review help articles on several features. Which of the following is one of them?
o: Fine-tuning custom models
Memory, Skills, and Code Execution
Prompt caching and rate limits
Deploying MCP servers to the cloud
e: Guide mục 7 liệt kê Projects, Artifacts, Memory, Skills, Code Execution. Các phương án khác là việc của developer. Bài 0.1.
